quests.title: Geri's Gastro-Nostalgia

dialogue.t: Ah yes, that would be my commission. Have you already prepared two Tea Break Pancakes?
These Tea Break Pancakes smell amazing! This is going to be a real treat.
Oh right, I'll need some more Almond Tofu to compare the tastes.
Oh! I almost forgot... These are for you, thanks for your help.

quests.description: Geri needs two Tea Break Pancakes.
